title: Maintenance.
officialText:
Installations, both existing and new, and parts thereof shall be maintained in proper operating condition in
accordance with the original design and in a safe condition. Devices or safeguards that are required by this code shall be maintained
in compliance with the applicable provisions under which they were installed.
